summary: In this Goodful video, Merle attempts a carrot-based vegan hot dog using a marinade-and-boil approach rather than a traditional grill technique. She trims and smooths whole carrots, then simulates a hot-dog shape by stripping and peeling the surface. A savory marinade is prepared from water, soy/amino acids, liquid smoke, vegan steak sauce, agave or maple syrup, ketchup, plus garlic and onion powders with cayenne and black pepper. The carrots are boiled in this marinade for 7–10 minutes, then cooled with a brief resting period before being dressed with classic hot-dog toppings like relish, onions, and ketchup. She experiments with a quick-freeze method to accelerate cooling and contemplates a miniature-carrot hack to shorten wait times. The tasting verdict is surprisingly positive—close to a real hot dog but intentionally not claimed to be identical—followed by reflections on taste, texture, and audience engagement. The video also notes composting carrot scraps and weaves in pop-culture nods (Tabitha Brown) and light humor throughout.
